sections.title: Collect three supplier quotations as multiple Form Fill responses
Map each response amount to the same incident amount field

groups.name: Procurement
groups.purpose: Proposed owner of the quotation collection: asks suppliers for quotations, records each response and records the selected quotation. Not confirmed by a supplied source.

flags.detail: The same group is proposed for collecting the quotations and for recording the selection that writes the case amount. Confirm with the process owner whether these must be different people (decision D2).

workflows.name: Supplier quotation collection

grants.reason: Procurement opens the case that collects the three quotations; no other starter was named in the request

access.note: Members of Procurement who start a case see every case of this workflow. Supplier prices are visible to that team by design; no other visibility was requested.

actions.name: Collect supplier quotations
evidence: Three responses to the form Supplier quotation, one per supplier
A quotation file attached to each response
A case comment for any supplier that declined or did not answer

folded.summary: Asking each supplier for a quotation is part of this action's method, not a separate action.

actions.name: Record the selected quotation
evidence: One response to the form Quotation selection with selection_rationale filled
incident_amount on the case equal to the selected supplier's quoted amount
single_source_justification filled when fewer than three quotations were collected

folded.summary: Comparing the three responses is a step of this action, not a separate review action.

setupNotes: Forms are not carried by the workflow YAML. Create both forms in Provia and link each one to its Form Fill action before publication.

Response policy is the design decision that makes this work: Collect supplier quotations accepts MULTIPLE responses and maps nothing; Record the selected quotation accepts ONE response and carries every mapping.

Confirm in the Provia form editor which of the mappings in forms.md are actually offered for the field types used. Mappings to currency (incident_amount) and rich text (selection_rationale) are designed, not verified.
Both actions are assigned to the group Procurement in this manifest. The YAML carries no assignee because no destination UUIDs are known; set the owner in Provia or supply receipts.
No deadline is configured on either action: none was supplied (decision D3).
Scope: this workflow covers the quotation collection only. The purchase request intake, the approval of the selected amount and the order to the supplier are not designed here.

forms.title: Supplier quotation
forms.mappingNote: No mappings. Three responses would be three competing values for one case field; a Form Fill action with multiple responses keeps them separate for review and does not write case metadata.

fields.label: Supplier
fields.help: Commercial name exactly as it appears on the quotation document.

fields.label: Supplier NIF
fields.help: Tax identification number, when the quotation states one.
fields.validation: Free text; no format is enforced because no supplier register was supplied.

fields.label: Quotation reference
fields.help: The supplier's own quotation or proposal number.

fields.label: Quotation date
fields.validation: Date; must not be later than today.

fields.label: Quoted amount
fields.help: Total quoted amount in Kz, on the same tax basis for every quotation compared.
fields.validation: Currency AOA, two decimals, greater than zero.

fields.label: Amount includes tax
fields.help: Tick when the quoted amount already includes IVA, so the three amounts are compared on the same basis.

fields.label: Quotation valid for (days)
fields.help: How long the supplier holds the price.

fields.label: Delivery time (days)
fields.help: Days from order to delivery, as stated by the supplier.

fields.label: Payment terms
fields.help: Terms stated on the quotation, for example 30 days after invoice.

fields.label: Scope matches the request
fields.help: Tick only when the quotation covers the same item, quantity and specification as the request.

fields.label: Quotation document
fields.help: The supplier's quotation as received. Needed as the evidence that the price was quoted and not estimated.
fields.validation: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB, one file per response.

fields.label: Notes on this quotation
fields.help: Exclusions, conditions or anything that makes this quotation hard to compare.

forms.title: Quotation selection
forms.mappingNote: This is the only response that writes case metadata, which is what keeps incident_amount single-valued.

fields.label: Quotations received
fields.help: How many responses were submitted to Collect supplier quotations.

fields.label: Selected supplier
fields.help: Must match the supplier name on one of the collected responses.
fields.validation: Free text; no cross-response lookup is available, so the value is typed and checked by the assignee.

fields.label: Selected quotation reference
fields.help: The quotation reference of the selected supplier.

fields.label: Selected amount
fields.help: The amount of the selected quotation, copied exactly from the supplier's document.
fields.validation: Currency AOA, two decimals, greater than zero.

fields.label: Why this quotation was selected
fields.help: State the criteria used. When the selected amount is not the lowest, say why.

fields.label: Justification for fewer than three quotations
fields.help: Fill only when fewer than three quotations were obtained: which suppliers were approached and why the others did not quote.
fields.validation: Free text; conditional display was not verified, so the field is shown always and left empty when three quotations exist.

decisions.question: Confirm that incident_amount must carry the selected quotation only. Three quotation amounts cannot share one case field; if the process instead needs all three amounts in case metadata, three separate single-response Form Fill actions writing quotation_1_amount, quotation_2_amount and quotation_3_amount are the alternative (see forms.md, Alternative B).
Must the person who collects the quotations be different from the person who records the selection that writes the case amount?
What deadline applies to collecting the quotations and to recording the selection? No service level was supplied, so due is unset on both actions.

Do suppliers submit their own quotations, or does a member of Procurement transcribe them? Form Fill responses are collected inside an existing case; external or anonymous submission was not verified against the configured form behaviour.
Should the supplier be a Provia entity type, so the quotation form references a registered supplier instead of free text in supplier_name?
Who approves the selected amount once it reaches incident_amount, and above which value? No approval step or threshold was supplied, so none is designed.
